profile.summary: SLGC Berhad, an investment holding company, through its subsidiary, operates in the provision of building construction services, including external and ancillary works. It offers building construction services primarily as a contractor specialising in residential (landed and high rise) and non-residential (commercial and industrial) buildings. The company also provides external and ancillary works in the areas of construction works outside of the building, including drainage and sewerage connections, external utilities, footpaths, and driveways, as well as ancillary works to the supporting structures within the compound of a project that includes guardhouses, waste chambers, and lightings. In addition, it offers project planning and management, construction execution and completion, and handover of the project services; and engages the services of external subcontractors to various scope of works, including civil engineering works, M&E works, plumbing works, waterproofing works, and painting works. The company's design and build services include design works and construction phases of a project covering the project lifecycle from the design stage to the post-construction stage. It serves building owners and property developers in Malaysia. SLGC Berhad was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.
profile.zh: SLGC Berhad 是一家投资控股公司，通过其子公司提供建筑施工服务，包括外部及附属工程。公司成立于2009年，总部位于马来西亚新山，主要作为承包商服务于马来西亚的建筑业主和房地产开发商。
lines: 建筑施工服务：作为承包商承接住宅（有地及高层）和非住宅（商业及工业）建筑施工项目，客户为建筑业主和房地产开发商。
外部及附属工程：提供建筑外部施工工程，包括排水与排污接驳、外部公用设施、人行道和车道，以及项目范围内的附属工程如警卫室、垃圾房和照明。
项目管理服务：提供项目规划与管理、施工执行与竣工，以及项目移交服务。
分包管理：聘请外部分包商承担土木工程、机电工程、管道工程、防水工程和油漆工程等各类工作。
设计与建造服务：涵盖项目从设计阶段到施工后阶段的全生命周期设计与施工服务。
